name: JW Marriott Phoenix Desert Ridge Resort and Spa
insider_take: Desert luxury meets urban sophistication at this sprawling oasis where championship golf, world-class spa treatments, and stunning Sonoran Desert views create the ultimate Phoenix escape.
whats_special: This resort sits on 316 acres in the heart of the Sonoran Desert, featuring two championship golf courses designed by Arnold Palmer and Nick Faldo. The Revive Spa spans 77,000 square feet, making it one of the largest resort spas in Arizona. The property's unique desert architecture incorporates natural stone and earth tones that blend seamlessly with the surrounding landscape.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments during weekday mornings for the most serene experience, and don't miss the rooftop pool area at sunset when the desert sky transforms into brilliant oranges and purples.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Copperwynd Restaurant offers panoramic desert views from the 27th floor, while the nearby Desert Ridge Marketplace provides world-class shopping just steps away. Take advantage of the resort's unique "Desert Discovered" program, which includes guided desert walks to spot local wildlife like roadrunners, coyotes, and desert cottontails.
pros: Expansive resort with multiple pools and water features
Full-service spa and championship golf courses on-site
Desert Ridge Marketplace shopping and dining adjacent to property
Luxury JW Marriott brand standards and service excellence
cons: Large resort property requires walking distances between facilities
Premium pricing for luxury desert resort experience
